annotations.title: Set what your company takes from agents

description: For a member of a company that claimed its Alion page, connected with that account: which purposes agents may write to the company about (sales, partnership, supplier, press, investment, candidate, support, other) and how many new agent messages a day it takes. An empty purposes list closes the company to agents. Free. Docs: https://alion.io/developers/docs
